body_long:
Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel, has appointed Édouard Delavaux as its general manager. The hotel announced the move in a communiqué dated 18 November 2026, and he takes up the role on 11 January 2027.

## From La Réserve to Place de la Concorde

Delavaux has led La Réserve Paris since 2023. He has more than twenty years in luxury hotels behind him, including more than ten at Cheval Blanc and LVMH Hotel Management. He started at Cheval Blanc Courchevel, then moved to Cheval Blanc Paris as resident manager, where he took part in preparing and opening the hotel on the Seine.

Earlier in his career, he worked with the Yannick Alléno group on openings in Marrakech, Dubai, Beijing and Taipei.

## A childhood dream

In the announcement, Delavaux says he is proud and happy to join the Rosewood family, and describes the appointment as the fulfilment of a childhood dream. His brief is to keep developing the hotel, relying on its teams and on the quality of its welcome.

## The house he inherits

The Crillon stands at 10, place de la Concorde and counts 124 rooms and suites. It is one of the most visible palaces in Paris and one of Rosewood's European flagships.

The general manager's office opened up this autumn. Vincent Billiard, who led the hotel, joined LVMH Hotel Management as chief operating officer and member of its executive committee from 5 October 2026, taking charge of Cheval Blanc operations. Delavaux's appointment therefore reverses the path: a former Cheval Blanc executive now takes over the hotel that Billiard left for Cheval Blanc.

## The signal

The pool of leaders able to run a Paris palace is small, and the same houses keep exchanging talent: Cheval Blanc, La Réserve, the Crillon. Each appointment opens a seat elsewhere, and the next question is who will succeed Delavaux at La Réserve Paris.

Congratulations to Édouard Delavaux on his new role.

summary: The head of La Réserve Paris, a Cheval Blanc alumnus, takes over the Rosewood palace on Place de la Concorde on 11 January 2027, succeeding Vincent Billiard.
title: Édouard Delavaux named General Manager of Hôtel de Crillon
why: One of Paris's most visible palaces gets a new leader drawn from Cheval Blanc and La Réserve.
